name: smwgraphics-art-of-fighting-neo-geo-8x16-dialogue-fonts
title: Art of Fighting (Neo Geo) - 8x16 Dialogue Fonts
description:
This is a collection of the English alphabet fonts from the Neo Geo version of Art of Fighting. Its size is 8x16 and it contains Spanish and Portuguese orthography.

This font uses 8 colors mapped to the right-side palette on Row 5. It comes with two palette: the red font from the game's dialogue box ("Palette 1") and the blue font from its score board screen ("Palette 2"). README.txt contains their RGB values if you want to remap the palette to use both.
